body: Owner, 2026-10-03. Sessions carry an app data field stored as JSON bytes by every session store (SQL, Redis, memory, custom; the sessiontest suite enforces it), read and written through typed generic accessors on the app's own Go struct. A plugin also offers the separate-table approach. Session stores stay fully pluggable.
title: Per-session app data: a typed JSON data field on every session, plus a plugin, both offered
